2363-4659-5224-7646.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1} due to Krallenhorde Howler, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2317-2511-6664-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

2099-4574-6900-7435--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
2099-4574-6900-7435--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

141-1854-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-3967.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2961-3175-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, False Demise triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat
392-5220-6797-7855--180.notes: The chosen Goblin, Orc or Army must be castable for {R}.

240-5470-5686-7297.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7156.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4050-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4050-4716.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

38-5220-6094-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1003-2173-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1580-2018-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities from steps 1 and 5
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2558-2981-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-2981-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Megatog to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1356-1651-1872-4574-6694.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Composite Golem from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Oracle's Vault's second ability by tapping it, exiling Composite Golem from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn without playing its mana cost.
Cast Composite Golem from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and creating a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Composite Golem, untapping Oracle's Vault.
Repeat.

4067-5672-6478.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

560-4550-4616-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-4616-5147.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Moldervine Reclamation triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards and gain 2 life.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Repeat.

582-1912-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Brazen Freebooter.
When Brazen Freebooter enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1809-1987-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1809-1987-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and Peregrine Drake.
When Returned Pastcaller and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1809-1987-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1461-2403-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Moonlit Wake trigger twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2308-2741.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-2741.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

431-1744-3129.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating twice that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2382-2557-4404.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3}, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor with haste.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Mimic Vat and any other permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Corridor Monitor tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-3270-5220.manaNeeded: {4}{U/B}{U/B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-3270-5220.description:
Cast Gyruda by paying {4}{U/B}{U/B} and commander tax, if applicable.
Gyruda enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gyruda, adding {C}{C}.
Gyruda dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Gyruda on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Gyruda ability from step 2, causing each player to mill four cards and you to return Gyruda from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

331-2037-3059.notablePrerequisites: Minsc & Boo has at least two loyalty counters on it.
331-2037-3059.description: Activate Minsc & Boo's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, sacrificing Malignus and dealing damage equal to two times Malignus's power to target opponent.

65-717-2628-3855-4652.description:
Activate Remote Isle's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Remote Isle, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Remote Isle trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Remote Isle and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
